description: This file is the main entry point for a Flutter application. It defines the root widget 'MyApp' which sets up the MaterialApp with a theme and home page. The home page widget 'MyHomePage' displays a simple scaffold with an app bar and centered content indicating that the app is being generated.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: A stateless widget that sets up the MaterialApp with title, theme, and home page.

classes.name: MyHomePage
classes.description: A stateful widget representing the home page, requiring a title parameter.

classes.name: _MyHomePageState
classes.description: State class for MyHomePage, builds the Scaffold with app bar and centered message.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The main entry point of the application, calls runApp with MyApp instance.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for MyApp and _MyHomePageState, setting up MaterialApp and Scaffold.
